rows.label: Personal allowance
rows.note: residents only; one twelfth of the annual allowance for each month of residence in a part year; non-residents get none. The Income Tax (Amendment) Bill 2026, which would have raised the allowance to £7,150 from 1 April 2026, was not passed by the Legislative Council on 20 March 2026, so the £7,000 allowance applies in 2026-27.
